note: Community-measured pull-rate estimates, expressed as packs per hit of ANY card of the tier. Curated by hand; the UI must always label derived values as estimates. Keys may be a card rarity (e.g. 'Special Illustration Rare') or a section slug (e.g. 'signatures'); a section key wins when both match, which lets tiers that share a rarity string (Riftbound's Showcase cards) carry different rates. Per-card odds multiply by the count of matching cards in the set. Set-level entries override the game default. Tiers without an entry render as unavailable.
sources: Pokemon: aggregated community opening data (JustInBasil-style rate summaries and TCGplayer pull-rate articles) for the Scarlet & Violet / Mega Evolution era. Riftbound: community per-box estimates (Epic ~6/box, Alt Art ~2/box, Showcase/Overnumbered ~1 per 3 boxes, Signature ~1 per 30 boxes), applied across all sets until per-set data exists.
